req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-003 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string. The schema uses Pydantic's TaskCreate which declares title as str; sending a non-string type (integer, boolean, list, null, float, object) must trigger Pydantic validation and FastAPI must return 422. Tests cover: (1) positive – valid string title accepted with 201; (2) negative – integer title rejected with 422; (3) boundary – boolean title rejected with 422 (bool is a subclass of int in Python but Pydantic strict-ish coercion may or may not coerce; we test the boundary between coercible and non-coercible types); additional negatives cover null, list, float, and object to maximise mutation kill rate by asserting the exact status code 422 in every case.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body

test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
